mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN i.used_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'USED' WHEN #{on}::date BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to THEN 'USABLE' ELSE 'OUT_OF_PERIOD' END FROM coupon_issue i JOIN coupon c ON c.coupon_id = i.coupon_id WHERE i.issue_id = #{couponIssueId} AND i.customer_id = #{customerId}
INSERT INTO purchase (customer_id, amount, coupon_issue_id, created_by, purchased_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{amount}, #{couponIssueId}, #{createdBy}, #{purchasedAt}) RETURNING purchase_id
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET total_purchase = total_purchase + #{amount}, updated_at = now() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.sql: SELECT p.purchase_id, p.amount, p.coupon_issue_id, c.name AS coupon_name, p.purchased_at FROM purchase p LEFT JOIN coupon_issue i ON i.issue_id = p.coupon_issue_id LEFT JOIN coupon c ON c.coupon_id = i.coupon_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY p.purchased_at DESC, p.purchase_id DESC
